observatory.label: Observatory
observatory.description: Constellation’s own — a deep-navy night sky, or a cool daybreak in light.

default.label: Default
default.description: Cool near-black with a navy tint and an indigo accent — balanced, classy, premium.

dim.label: Dim
dim.description: Blue-grey at half chroma with softer type — the low-contrast palette.

warm.label: Warm
warm.description: Ivory, tan and brown with a clay-orange accent — the Claude palette.

void.label: Void
void.description: Monochrome from white to true black — borderless, high contrast, Vercel-like.

light.label: Light
light.description: Everything lit — a light-grey frame with a white panel on it.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Soft dark — dark structure with the grounds lifted to mid grey and the type dimmed a stop.

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: Everything dark, the frame a step darker than the panel.

system.label: System
system.description: Follow the operating system between light and dark.
